title: Ansem says his Pump wallet was hacked and suspects unauthorized access to his Bullpen account
date_note: Both articles are dated 24 November and give no earlier day.
summary: Crypto trader Ansem said his Pump wallet was hacked and that unauthorized access to his Bullpen profile appears to have occurred, according to Bloomingbit's report citing CoinDesk. Lookonchain's X post, relayed by PANews, says 215 万枚 USDC has so far been transferred to a wallet on Arbitrum; Bloomingbit says CoinDesk could not confirm that figure. Bloomingbit says the method and total damage were still under investigation.
plain: Crypto trader Ansem says his wallet was hacked and suspects someone got into his Bullpen account. How it happened and the total loss are not yet established.
exec: The wallet owner himself reports a hack; the method and total losses are not yet established.

sources.name: PANews: Ansem 钱包疑遭黑客攻击，约 215 万 USDC 被转移
Bloomingbit: 룩온체인 ANSEM 관련 지갑 해킹 정황

evidence.quote: 目前已转移 215 万枚 USDC

validation.note: Bloomingbit (relaying CoinDesk) quotes Ansem's own statement; PANews and an earlier Bloomingbit article relay Lookonchain's X post. The CoinDesk original and the X post were not read.

review.note: status and severity: individual's unestablished hack set to developing, severity 1; figure normalised, CoinDesk non-confirmation of 2.15M USDC added
